title: Employer business demography by size class and NACE Rev. 2 activity (2004-2020)

dimensions.label: Economical indicator for structural business statistics

options.label: Population of active enterprises in t - number
Births of enterprises in t - number
Deaths of enterprises in t - number
Persons employed in the population of active enterprises in t - number
Business churn: birth rate + death rate - percentage
Birth rate: number of enterprise births in the reference period (t) divided by the number of enterprises active in t - percentage
Death rate: number of enterprise deaths in the reference period (t) divided by the number of enterprises active in t - percentage
1 year old enterprises' share of the business population - percentage
Enterprises newly born in the year (n) having survived to n+1 - number
Cohort survival rate 1: newly born enterprises in the year (n) having survived to (n+1) divided by the number of enterprise births in (n) - number

One-year old enterprises employment growth rate: persons employed in the year (n+1) among enterprises newly born in (n) having survived to n+1 divided by the number of persons employed in (n) by the same enterprises - number

dimensions.label: Statistical classification of economic activities in the European Community (NACE Rev. 2)
